text:
clio (design): Quick riff: drop the persistent schema banner and add a tiny validation marker on each function row (a small "!" pill). clicking expands a short inline panel with line-level errors + jump links. keeps the editor clean. matt (devex): sounds promising. two Qs: badge on row only? and should the panel be inline or a floating popover? inline seems less disruptive. clio (design): row-only + inline. shows the failing field snippet and a link that focuses the offending input. rahul (backend): backend thumbs up. implementation note: re-run the linter when panel opens but debounce 250ms, and cache results for 30s to avoid repeat runs. jo (a11y): accessibility: the inline panel must be role=region with aria-label="Function validation" and use aria-live=polite for new errors. keyboard: Enter toggles, Shift+Enter jumps to first error link, Esc closes and returns focus. matt (devex): will add keyboard flow + visible focus ring. also propose making the pin a toggle button with aria-pressed. clio (design): parallel idea for run history: introduce a compact run-preview card that shows tool name, a single-line summary (first sentence), tiny cost chip (tokens / $) and a chevron. expand reveals full structured output tabs (Request / Response / Meta) and supports streaming. sophie (product): cost chip is very useful for PMs. show approximate tokens and USD when available; hide if unknown. rollout: beta to 10% of org and measure expand rate + avg cost per run. rahul (backend): data contract suggestion: summaryText (<=256 chars), pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, timestamp. store only summary + pointer on the list and lazy-load full payload on expand. streaming runs mark isStreaming=true so UI shows live indicator. jo (a11y): copy tweak: prefer "Call arguments" instead of "Args". when expanded, announce "Tool output expanded" and ensure the cost chip has an accessible aria-label (e.g., "Estimated cost: 12 tokens, $0.02"). matt (devex): UI details: compact card shows a pulsing dot when streaming; truncate at sentence boundary if possible. on expand, animate and move focus into the panel, trap focus until closed. Esc closes. rahul (backend): backend action: draft RFC for pointer contract + caching and add debounce to linter endpoint. pointer should be an internal id referencing object store. clio (design): tiny code idea for the panel: ```
    ...
``` sophie (product): action list: 1) rahul RFC + pointer, 2) matt keyboard/focus RFC, 3) jo a11y checklist, 4) clio final frames + copy, 5) sophie set experiment config. beta gate: revert if avg cost delta > 10%. preview-bot: clio uploaded preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/validation-pill-and-run-preview matt (devex): thanks! I'll own the keyboard flow doc and make a small accessibility checklist for Jo to sign off. :rocket:
